hypernyms.def: a mechanism that controls the operation of a machine
exp: the speed controller on his turntable was not working properly
I turned the controls over to her
hypernyms.gloss: a mechanism that controls the operation of a machine; "the speed controller on his turntable was not working properly"; "I turned the controls over to her"

hypernyms.def: device consisting of a piece of machinery
exp: has moving parts that perform some function
hypernyms.gloss: device consisting of a piece of machinery; has moving parts that perform some function

hypernyms.def: an instrumentality invented for a particular purpose
exp: the device is small enough to wear on your wrist
a device intended to conserve water
hypernyms.gloss: an instrumentality invented for a particular purpose; "the device is small enough to wear on your wrist"; "a device intended to conserve water"

hypernyms.def: an artifact (or system of artifacts) that is instrumental in accomplishing some end
hypernyms.gloss: an artifact (or system of artifacts) that is instrumental in accomplishing some end

hypernyms.def: a man-made object taken as a whole
hypernyms.gloss: a man-made object taken as a whole

hypernyms.def: an assemblage of parts that is regarded as a single entity
exp: how big is that part compared to the whole?
hypernyms.gloss: an assemblage of parts that is regarded as a single entity; "how big is that part compared to the whole?"; "the team is a unit"

exp: an entity that can cast a shadow
it was full of rackets, balls and other objects
hypernyms.gloss: a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow; "it was full of rackets, balls and other objects"

hypernyms.def: an entity that has physical existence
hypernyms.gloss: an entity that has physical existence

hypernyms.def: that which is perceived or known or inferred to have its own distinct existence (living or nonliving)
hypernyms.gloss: that which is perceived or known or inferred to have its own distinct existence (living or nonliving)

word.def: any of various controls or devices for regulating or controlling fluid flow, pressure, temperature, etc.
word.gloss: any of various controls or devices for regulating or controlling fluid flow, pressure, temperature, etc.
